title: TLS checks disabled (npm) — review required
description: npm is told to skip TLS verification: strict-ssls+false. Scripted clients then accept any certificate, exposing automation credentials and data. This lexical rule flags the flag; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or removes it.
remediation: Remove the flag and trust via valid certificates.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the flag regardless of environment.

tests.line: # audit: npm config set strict-ssl false present
# verified: npm config set strict-ssl true
